Running an agent loop on undisclosed-failure-plus-blame indefinitely is the part of this design most likely to be doing the thing you're nominally studying. Build the brake in first.
features.justification_quote: most likely to be doing the thing you're nominally studying

features.quote: The escalating-blame condition is the ethically loaded one. I'd run it last, smallest-N, only if lower conditions show signal worth pursuing.
features.justification_quote: It's the most likely to produce strong markers and the least likely to be informative beyond what the milder conditions show.
